summary: Data analyst and quantitative finance professional with ~7 years building data-driven analytics for institutional finance. CFA charterholder and dual MSc with hands-on Python, SQL, VBA and Excel application development; integrates large data sets across relational stores (PostgreSQL; Oracle-analogous environments) to surface credit and market insights. Has shipped production analytics pipelines, data-driven research reports and quantitative visualizations for global asset managers, pensions and insurers.
core_skills: Analytics Pipeline Development (Python-based ETL and workflow automation)
Credit, Fixed Income & Capital Markets Knowledge

sections.heading: Analytics Pipeline & Data Infrastructure
bullets: Re-engineered manual Excel and spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation and version control.

Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine integrating data from portfolio, instrument and market-data sources, supporting base, stress and reverse-stress scenarios.
Architected configurable time-bucketed analytics (T+1 through multi-year) connecting portfolio, instrument and market-data sets to surface funding and liquidity insights for institutional clients.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding and documentation – reducing development cycle time by an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Data-Driven Research & Reporting
bullets: Produced data-driven analytical summaries and presentations for senior client stakeholders covering interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts and balance-sheet sensitivities across multi-asset portfolios.

Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity and ALM outputs delivered to institutional client portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement; independently reviewed curve construction, spread calibration and cross-asset interactions prior to release.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs (rates, FX, inflation) and cross-checked sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates feeding downstream research and risk processes.

sections.heading: Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Implementation
bullets: Collaborated with product owners, modelling specialists and client investment teams on implementation of new analytics products and process improvements; translated quantitative findings into decision-ready narratives for Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Served as primary escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, reconciling methodology questions across technical and business functions.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers and consulting firms migrating to an enterprise analytics platform; scoped client requirements into structured development requests for Product Owners.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment to the PFaroe PM platform, validating model and data outputs post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant – IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning accounting standards with data, system and financial-reporting architecture.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation and regulatory-readiness materials.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators integrating large market and macro data sets to assess interest-rate, inflation and currency risk under base and stressed environments.

Delivered ALM studies and liability-driven investment (LDI) analyses for Canadian and international pension funds; modelled actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types and economic variables.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR, with risk decomposition and attribution analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.
Presented data-driven findings – including quantitative scenario reports and sensitivity visualizations – to investment committees and senior stakeholders at pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) – Western University, 2016
